services.desc: Elk Rapids, Charlevoix, Boyne City, Bay Harbor, Petoskey and Harbor Springs can all be round tripped in a day from Traverse City. Charlevoix is just under two hours and Petoskey just under 30 minutes farther. The Leelanau Peninsula offers some of the most beautiful scenery on earth. A start at Leland’s Harbor puts the Manitou Islands, Sleeping Bear National Lakeshore, and Frankfort within a days range to be explored. Trailering AMBITIOUS to Cheboygan opens up the Inland Waterway - including passage through the Cheboygan River Lock, raising us to the beauty of Mullet, Burt, Crooked Lake, and Indian River.
